At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for:

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate.

Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

Flexible, project‑based opportunity well‑suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, experienced professionals and consultants with strong critical thinking skills.
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity.

About the project

You will create complex, realistic tasks that push frontier AI agents to their limits. Think scattered data, conditional procedures, and genuine domain expertise required. You’ll build a detailed version with objective scoring, then write an ambiguous version intended to train the agent to succeed with less hand‑holding. Real expert complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

How to get started

Apply to this post and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. To begin working in production you’ll need to complete the qualification step and project onboarding, where you’ll get familiar with the guidelines interface and try your first real task with guidance from our quality team. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll be directly shaping how useful these models become for your own future work.

Requirements

  • You hold a Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Accounting, Auditing, Financial Accounting, or closely aligned areas. Having a chartered accountancy qualification such as CPA, ACCA, or ICAEW is an advantage.
  • You have a professional industry experience in accounting with a minimum of 3 years in relevant fields (e.g., audit, financial reporting, internal controls, tax, management accounting).
  • You are familiar with US GAAP standards.
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above.
  • Experience in cross‑functional, applied, or international projects will be an advantage, especially if your expertise has been used in real‑world or consulting contexts.

  • Creativity in designing realistic and engaging examples, cases, or workflows based on your domain knowledge.
  • Motivation to work with challenging, complex, but well‑defined guidelines, learn new methods, and strengthen domain‑specific skills.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly, and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $16/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.

Job description

Somos mais de 40 mil pessoas que atuam com foco em segurança, integridade, colaboração e simplificação, os pilares que sustentam nossa cultura.

Geramos valor para nossos acionistas, clientes e parceiros e colaboradores a partir de umecossistema integrado de negócios que começa com o cultivo da cana-de-açúcar até chegar na produção e comercialização de etanol, açúcar e bioenergia.

Atuamos ainda – sob licença da marca Shell – na distribuição de combustíveis, lubrificantes e outras especialidades no Brasil, além de operações de refino na Argentina e distribuição de derivados de combustíveis e lubrificantes na Argentina e no Paraguai.

Se identificou?

Estamos em busca de Analista de SSMA para atuar no time de Lubrificantes na Ilha do Governador/RJ.

Main responsibilities

COMO SERÁ O SEU DIA A DIA:

  • Conduzir e manter o Sistema de Gestão Integrado (ISO 9001, 14001 e 45001), assegurando conformidade com requisitos normativos e corporativos;
  • Realizar o cumprimento e controle de todas as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) aplicáveis à operação da planta;
  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar auditorias internas, bem como apoiar auditorias externas;
  • Elaborar, revisar e controlar procedimentos, instruções, relatórios e planos de ação relacionados a SSMA;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho e propor melhorias baseadas em análise crítica e prevenção de riscos;
  • Identificar desvios e oportunidades, conduzindo ações corretivas e preventivas junto às áreas operacionais;
  • Organizar e realizar treinamentos, campanhas e programas de conscientização de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;
  • Atuar em campo para identificar riscos, apoiar equipes operacionais e reforçar a cultura de SSMA.

Requirements and skills

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Segurança do Trabalho, Meio Ambiente ou áreas correlatas;

title: Metering Engineer
description:
This position will support FPSO operations by overseeing and ensuring the integrity of all metering systems. It will involve monitoring system performance, validating data, and providing daily operational support. The role will also act as the Technical Authority for metering, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements, including ANP and INMETRO standards.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring that all fluid metering systems at FPSO are performed in accordance with the technical requirements and legal deadlines, meeting the requirements outlined in Joint Resolution ANP / INMETRO 01: 2013 (RTM).
  • Provide technical support daily, in relation to measurement problems in the FPSO.
  • Participate/assist in metering audits.
  • Act as Technical Authority to measurement issues.
  • Verify that FPSO operator’s procedures and manuals are in accordance with current ANP, ISO and other relevant standards for offshore oil and natural gas flow measurement (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Manage and monitor the status of the flow metering systems (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Conduct critical analysis of failure reports, calibrations and periodic maintenance of fiscal, allocation and custody transfer metering systems in accordance with RTM and applicable standards.
  • Verify, validate and submit data (failure reports, flow computer data, well test reports and monthly production report) related to the FPSO metering systems to ANP.
  • Keep updated the measurement points registered in the SFP (ANP production system).
  • Validate offloading measurement reports.
  • Verify the operational history of seal removal and installation.
  • Verify that the FPSO operator is following calibration plans, uncertainty calculations, and required flow computer upgrades.
  • Verify / validate in case of measurement system failure the volume estimate as specified in ANP resolutions.
  • Verify / monitor backups of measurement equipment information, fault history, equipment replacement, and parameter changes.
  • Carry out the planning and control of the sample collection service for chemical analysis, interface with logistics for loading / unloading materials related to the samples, and, if necessary, validate the results of PVT and chromatographic analysis. After validation, monitor the results/inform the need to update the flow computers.
  • Follow up the routines to keep the Metering Management System in operation without non-conformities.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Automation, Petroleum, Production, Chemical Engineering or related.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems.
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc.
  • Advanced English (oral and written).

description:
Join to apply for the Condition Based Monitoring Lead role at SBM Offshore

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably.

Purpose

As Condition Based Monitoring Lead, you are responsible for leading the CBM team driving an effective and efficient execution and management of the global CBM program compliant with internal and external requirements (e.g. classification bodies). You support operating regions and assets in realizing optimal performance of rotating equipment on offshore assets.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the global CBM team.
  • Ensure effective and efficient execution and management of the global CBM program.
  • Collaborate closely with other departments to ensure optimal performance of rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs by supporting operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, failure investigation and continuous improvement activities.
  • Maintain compliance with internal and external requirements, including Preventive Maintenance Program requirements from relevant classification bodies.
  • Manage CBM governance processes, tools and strategies to drive performance.
  • Stay updated on the latest advancements in CBM technologies and best practices.
  • Manage the Vibration & Oil Analysis Database and other CBM tools and software.
  • Drive the CBM work process automation program using data analytics/AI.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field is required.
  • Minimum ISO 18436-2 Cat III certification.
  • Offshore survival and medical certification desirable/required.

Experience

  • Experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Advanced knowledge in Machinery Condition Monitoring.
  • Good knowledge of Bently Nevada System 1 or ADRE; Rotor dynamic knowledge.
  • Knowledge of Omnitrend is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of rotating machinery, including compressors, turbines, and pumps.
  • Proficiency in using diagnostic tools and software for equipment analysis.
  • Knowledge of predictive maintenance technologies and practices.
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate a team.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills; self‑motivated and enthusiastic.

Functional Competencies

  • Mechanical Rotating Equipment – Vibration Analysis
  • Mechanical Rotating Equipment – Tribology
  • Integrity and Reliability – Remote Surveillance and Monitoring
  • Integrity and Reliability – Predictive Maintenance
  • Mechanical Rotating Equipment – Gas Compressor

description:
ESPECIALISTA DE CX (Jornada | UX | Comunicação)

Buscamos um profissional organizado, analítico e sensível para cuidar da experiência do cliente (CX), assegurando que cada interação na jornada e toda a comunicação sejam consistentes, claras e realmente valiosas. Sua missão será garantir que a experiência do cliente seja fluida e coesa em todos os pontos de contato:

  • Mapeamento e Otimização de Jornadas: Mapear, analisar, documentar e otimizar continuamente as jornadas do cliente, identificando pontos de dor (pain points), oportunidades de melhoria e gargalos de atrito para elevar a satisfação e retenção, contribuindo diretamente para o nosso alto NPS.
  • Gestão de Mensageria e Conteúdo (CX Writing): Cuidar de toda a mensageria (textos, comunicações, notificações e micro-textos), garantindo que estejam alinhados, acessíveis e alinhados à jornada do cliente.
  • Integração com a Tecnologia: Atuar lado a lado com o time de Produto e Tecnologia para desenvolver e implantar soluções que impactem positivamente a jornada e experiência dos nossos clientes.
  • Governança e Documentação: Organizar, documentar e ser o ponto focal para garantir o alinhamento e a disseminação de conhecimento sobre as jornadas e guidelines de comunicação entre as áreas envolvidas (ex: Marketing, Produto, Atendimento).
  • Análise de Dados de CX: Utilizar dados e feedbacks de clientes para embasar decisões e medir o impacto das melhorias implementadas nas jornadas e na comunicação, com foco na manutenção e aumento do NPS.
  • Formação/Experiência: Sólida formação ou experiência comprovada em Design (UX/UI), Comunicação, Marketing, Produto ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Pessoa extremamente detalhista, organizada e com alta sensibilidade para trabalhar com a experiência e a comunicação humana (empatia e escuta ativa).
  • Visão Customer Centric: Capacidade de colocar o cliente no centro de todas as decisões e enxergar de forma holística todos os pontos de contato (touchpoints) da jornada.
  • Habilidade de Colaboração: Facilidade e experiência em trabalhar com diferentes equipes multifuncionais, especialmente times de Tecnologia, Produto, Operações.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita para defender o ponto de vista do cliente e traduzir complexidades em mensagens simples e eficazes.

Diferenciais:

title: Solution Specialist, Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Solution Specialist, Manager role at SITA

WELCOME TO SITA

Overview

At SITA , we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. We are present in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting‑edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team

Please submit your resume written in English and not in Spanish. Thank you.

As a Solution Specialist, Manager – Baggage Portfolio, you will bring deep knowledge of airport and airline baggage technology solutions and play a critical role in supporting SITA at Airports’ global sales success. Your impact will directly influence how we introduce and scale new, customer‑driven solutions in the air transport industry. You will work at the intersection of customer insight and technical expertise, guiding our sales and product strategy by deeply understanding customer pain points, translating those into compelling solution proposals, and delivering a seamless experience from opportunity to deal closure. To support SITA at Airports’ wider innovation and growth vision, this role demands Customer Centric Thinking – using customer journey mapping, customer‑driven design, and proactive engagement to ensure our solutions are designed around real‑world needs.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as the key interface between Sales geographies and central Product Management for complex deals and new solutions across the baggage technology portfolio.
  • Shape strategic customer proposals from early engagement through RFP response by applying deep knowledge of operational challenges and customer goals.
  • Guide customers through solution design processes based on a clear understanding of their pain points, business processes, and operational constraints.
  • Design and deliver product demos and solution workshops, showcasing the value of SITA’s baggage solutions in a customer’s specific context.
  • Provide customer intelligence and insights back into Product Management to help evolve the roadmap in line with real market demand.
  • Lead internal cross‑functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Delivery, Pricing, and Operations to co‑create solution proposals.
  • Partner with Sales and Business Development to define tailored account strategies and drive market penetration.
  • Support and influence pricing strategy and commercial modelling based on value‑driven outcomes for customers.
  • Participate in live trials, customer pilots, and PoC engagements to demonstrate measurable impact of solutions.
  • Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the global Solution Specialist Team, enabling best practices and regional insight exchange.

Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of airport/airline baggage technologies, including BIMs, BRS, MDS, and loading systems.
  • Technically fluent, with a solid grasp of cloud‑based solutions, APIs, and integration frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply customer journey mapping and insights to design solutions that solve pain points and exceed customer expectations.
  • Proven experience in customer‑centric presales processes, enabling solution design that drives customer satisfaction and commercial win rates.
  • Strong design thinking mindset, consistently approaching complex problems through iterative, user‑first solutioning.
  • Comfortable navigating high‑stakes, high‑urgency customer interactions and translating feedback into tangible solution improvements.
  • Ability to collaborate across geographies and functions to co‑create value with teams including Product Management, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Effective communicator with a talent for translating technical features into business value, able to engage at all stakeholder levels including C‑suite.
  • Commercially astute and analytically sound, capable of developing tailored pricing and go‑to‑market strategies.
  • Proficient in tools such as PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI, Visio, and Word for solution modelling and storytelling.

Nice‑to‑Have

  • Experience in introducing and scaling innovative solutions within the air transport industry.
  • Exposure to global aviation technology procurement and implementation cycles.
  • Familiarity with various pricing models and value‑based selling approaches.
  • Experienced professional in Information Technology, Airline/Airport passenger ground handling, or the broader Air Transport Industry technology domain.

What We Offer

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it’s like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Flex Week : Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)

⏰ Flex Day : Make your workday suit your life and plans

Flex Location : Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world

Employee Wellbeing : Access our 24/7 EAP and Champion Health platform for all‑around wellbeing

Strategic Proposal Analyst - Remote Work

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting‑edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world’s Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

When you apply for this position, you’re taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.

Strategic Proposal Analyst

We are seeking a Strategic Proposal Analyst to craft persuasive, high‑quality proposals and responses to RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs for custom software development and IT professional services engagements. This role requires exceptional English writing and analytical skills, as well as a strong understanding of how software development projects are structured and delivered through modern frameworks such as SDLC and Agile. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Delivery, and Technical teams to shape narratives that demonstrate value, feasibility, and differentiation. This is a hands‑on, analytical, and strategic role, ideal for someone who can think critically, connect delivery details to business outcomes, and craft executive‑ready content that builds client confidence.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the end‑to‑end creation of proposals and RFx responses for project‑based IT and software development engagements.
  • Synthesize diverse inputs from technical, delivery, and commercial teams into structured, client‑focused narratives.
  • Write and refine executive summaries, delivery approaches, value propositions, and differentiators to effectively communicate key messages.
  • Ensure responses are strategically positioned, technically feasible, and commercially competitive.
  • Manage proposal schedules, stakeholder reviews, and final submissions to meet deadlines with quality and precision.
  • Partner with Solution Architects, Delivery Managers, and Sales Executives to ensure proposals reflect accurate delivery logic and business goals.
  • Develop and maintain reusable proposal content including case studies, delivery narratives, success stories, and templates.
  • Create presentation materials and sales collateral to support presales discussions.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of proposal processes, templates, and content libraries.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3‑5 years of experience in IT outsourcing, consulting, or professional services, with hands‑on involvement in developing proposals and RFP/RFI responses for software development or IT delivery engagements.
  • Demonstrated experience writing and structuring proposals for software development or IT delivery projects.
  • Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and delivery frameworks such as Agile and Scrum.
  • Knowledge of engagement models and pricing structures including Time & Materials, Fixed‑Price, and Managed Services.
  • Understanding of project phases such as Discovery, Design, Build, QA, and Deployment.
  • Proven ability to interpret technical or delivery input and convert it into persuasive business narratives.
  • Outstanding English writing and communication skills, able to create concise, executive‑level documents for global audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Communications, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
  • High proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms).
  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Slack is a plus.
  • Familiarity with UX/UI, AI, or digital transformation concepts is a plus.

How We Make Your Work (and Your Life) Easier

  • 100% remote work (from anywhere).
  • Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred.
  • Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
  • Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
  • Paid parental leave, vacations, and national holidays.
  • Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
  • Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at BairesDev by 2x.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most significant open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

Sobre a Unimed Ferj

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

description:
Realizar avaliação fonoaudiológica, definindo diagnósticos e tratamentos de alterações na comunicação que incluam a habilitação e reabilitação neuromuscular, assim como aquelas relacionadas às funções básicas de sucção, mastigação, deglutição e respiração, se utilizando ainda de técnicas específicas e direcionadas para cada caso. Atuar junto à equipe multidisciplinar na elaboração de metas de cuidados de acordo com cada perfil. Orientar cuidadores e familiares para condução de processo de alta hospitalar.

Responsabilidades:

  • Avaliar, realizar prognóstico, estabelecer o tipo de consistência alimentar, indicação de via alternativa a ser utilizada quando necessário, adequar as funções para retirada de sonda com segurança, controle no risco de broncoaspiração e aceleração no processo de alta;
  • Elaborar programas de tratamento fonoterápico, de acordo com diagnóstico médico e fonoaudiológico clínico, indicar exames complementares se necessário e técnicas disponíveis;
  • Prescrever e orientar a utilização de recursos a serem aplicados em todas as fases do tratamento, através de ações preventivas, restauradoras, de suporte e paliativa;
  • Orientar pacientes e cuidadores quanto às condutas adotadas em sua recuperação, através da demonstração, treinamento e avaliação da execução das técnicas, a fim de que se possa obter êxito no tratamento, conscientizando da importância no processo de recuperação ou controle dos sintomas;
  • Desenvolver terapias de reabilitação de distúrbios da comunicação oral, voz e linguagem dos pacientes através de técnicas e métodos indicados para cada caso, a fim de obter a reabilitação do paciente;
  • Realizar exames orofaciais em pacientes, avaliando posturas musculares em repouso e em movimento, tonicidade, movimentos involuntários e habilidades de lábios e língua, formato do palato, bem como da face, através de expressão e movimentos a fim de avaliar a harmonia e função dos órgãos fonoarticulares;
  • Avaliar e identificar as fases comprometidas da deglutição, observando suas estruturas e seu funcionamento, identificando as fases comprometidas e classificando as disfalagias, definindo condutas terapêuticas para a reabilitação do paciente;
  • Analisar e avaliar pacientes no decorrer do tratamento, observando a evolução do processo, promovendo ajustes necessários na terapia adotada, bem como emitindo laudos e pareceres técnicos baseados no histórico de cada paciente, a fim de acompanhar o tratamento adotado;
  • Participar da elaboração de protocolos de tratamento junto à equipe multidisciplinar, a fim de que sejam definidas diretrizes em relação a cada área específica e afins;
  • Participar das discussões clínicas (rounds) e reuniões de equipe.

Qualificação:

  • Diploma de Graduação/Bacharelado em Fonoaudiologia;
  • Especialização em Fonoaudiologia Hospitalar;
  • Experiência na área hospitalar;
  • Conhecimento do negócio/perfil dos grupos de cuidado;
  • Missão, visão e valores Institucionais;

Contratação como Pessoa Jurídica

A cadeia de saúde no Brasil tinha uma lacuna entre o modelo altamente tecnológico voltado para tratamento intensivo do hospital geral e o seu retorno para a sua residência.

Por este motivo, o Hospital Placi chegou para ocupar esse espaço no tratamento pós agudo, oferecendo um atendimento humanizado e acolhedor com uma proposta do cuidado individualizado para:

  • Reabilitação;
  • Readequação de cuidados;
  • Cuidados Paliativos Oncológicos e não oncológicos;

Inauguramos em 2013 a nossa primeira unidade em Niterói com a missão de: acolher, cuidar e recuperar pessoas. Não paramos por aí! Em 2016, expandimos para Botafogo e em breve novas unidades estarão próximas a você.

Nossa essência é "cuidar Bem é fazer Bem" e para isso contamos com uma equipe interdisciplinar com excelência tecnicapara fornecer todo o suporte aos pacientes, familiares e equipe assistente.

Seguimos com o propósito de trazer vida para todos os momentos de vida , levando o cuidado certo no momento certo!

Somos pessoas cuidando de pessoas. Atuamos com relação próxima e respeitosa, temos orgulho de fazer a diferença no cuidado de todos aqueles que precisam dos nossos serviços.

Mais do que um hospital de transição, somos um time que tem como propósito cuidar!

Quer fazer parte dessa história para cuidarmos juntos dos nossos pacientes?

Inscreva-se em uma de nossas oportunidades e venha ser um profissional do time Placi Cuidados Extensivos .

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

É necessário possuir ficha limpa junto às autoridades policiais, ser brasileiro(a), ter mais de 18 anos e possuir pelo menos o Ensino Médio completo. Entre os requisitos estão raciocínio lógico, visão estratégica e sistêmica, capacidade de comunicação interpessoal, desenvolvimento proativo e senso crítico. Ser graduado e especializado na área, com pós-graduação ou MBA e proficiência em outro idioma, principalmente inglês são requisitos obrigatórios.

Deve ter expertise em Google Analytics, publicidade paga e familiaridade com ferramentas de pesquisa e gerenciamento de palavras-chave.

  8. Gerente de Inteligência de Mercado

    Gerencia e estrutura a coleta de dados sobre a concorrência, tendências de consumo, comportamento do público e cenários do mercado, visando a definição de políticas e processos e apoia os departamentos de marketing, comunicação e vendas. Desejável ter conhecimento sobre mercado nacional e internacional, importação e exportação, além de Ensino Superior em economia, administração, marketing, estatística ou áreas relacionadas.

  9. Engenheiro Civil

    Profissional que planeja, projeta, executa e faz a gestão de obras de infraestrutura e empreendimento. É necessário ter graduação em engenharia civil e conhecimento em ferramentas técnicas como Excel, AutoCAD e SketchUp.

  10. Profissional ESG

    A profissional ressalta que a área de ESG tem crescido como um todo, por isso os cargos variam desde auxiliares, gestores a heads e diretores. Supervisionam estratégias e práticas ambientais, sociais e de governança, promovendo sustentabilidade, equidade e conformidade nas operações corporativas. Main responsibilities

  • Ciclo Técnico Completo: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida técnico das oportunidades, desde a compreensão dos requisitos do cliente até a definição da solução e proposta comercial.

  • Design de Soluções: Definir a topologia de rede e elaborar a lista de equipamentos (BoQ) para projetos de Datacom.
  • Interface com Cliente: Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes finais de diferentes mercados verticais, atuando com capacidade de interlocução junto a grandes empresas.
  • Suporte e Delivery: Oferecer suporte para a configuração dos equipamentos e atuar na resolução de problemas em níveis N1 e N2.
  • Elaboração de Propostas: Criar propostas técnicas detalhadas, garantindo a seleção correta de equipamentos.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Elétrica ou de Telecomunicações.
  • Experiência Técnica (Hard Skills):
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Datacom & Redes, com foco particular em equipamentos Huawei .
  • Experiência sólida na análise de especificações técnicas de processos licitatórios.
  • Experiência prática de campo, incluindo configuração, ativação e troubleshooting de Roteadores de Borda, Switches e WLAN.
  • Experiência na elaboração de propostas técnicas e definição de topologias.
  • Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):
  • Perfil comunicativo para interface com diversas áreas e clientes.
  • Proatividade frente a novos desafios e aprendizado de novas tecnologias.
  • Extrema atenção aos detalhes, especialmente na análise de editais e propostas.

Additional information

Serão considerados diferenciais competitivos para esta posição:

  • Inglês Intermediário.
  • Certificação HCIP Datacom da Huawei .
  • Certificações na área de Cibersegurança.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer‑a‑friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high‑performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now

and become a valued part of our growing team!

MISSÃO

VISÃO

Entregar a melhor experiência de aprendizagem a cada vez mais alunos com eficiência, uso intensivo de tecnologia e qualidade acadêmica em cada uma das nossas marcas, possibilitando um salto nas opções de vida do egresso.

Agimos como donos, entregamos resultado em equipe.

O novo nos atrai, soluções simples também.

Diversidade e ética

Fazemos o certo, valorizamos as diferenças e a diversidade.

Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têmo aluno no centro da decisão , pois consideramos o seu sucessocomo nosso.

Com uma forteapropriação da cultura digital , atuamos por meio do desenvolvimento de metodologias e de conteúdos que refletem os desafios e as necessidades do nosso tempo.

️Temos um grupo dealta liderança extremamente sênior e competente, que nos guia com segurança sobre a estratégia da organização.

️ Estamos dedicados em contribuir para redução do problema estratégico de Diversidade & Inclusão no país, implementando umprograma estruturado e colocando o tema constantemente em pauta com a alta liderança.

We are seeking a qualified and creative Instructional Designer to develop learning experiences for the Downstream Learning and Development Department (DLDD) that enhance downstream workforce capability.   • Design and produce polished PowerPoint presentations for instructor‑led and virtual training sessions.

  • Ensure learning materials meet accessibility standards and follow organizational branding.

Qualifications

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in instructional design, curriculum development, or program evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design frameworks, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience designing and developing training content aligned with learning objectives and organizational needs.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.

  • Advanced proficiency with PowerPoint for designing instructor‑led content, visual layouts, and prototypes.
  • Solid foundation in learning science and the ability to design engaging, learner‑centered content across digital, instructor‑led, and blended delivery formats.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn to challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, we invest heavily in talent development and provide world‑scale projects with significant capital and technology investment.

Aramco energizes the world economy with one of the largest hydrocarbon producer portfolios and a commitment to enhance value to society. description:
Join to apply for the Senior Financial Analyst (FP&A) role at Ottomatik.io .

2 days ago – Be among the first 25 applicants.

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst !

Note to Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst with strong FP&A experience and robust GAAP knowledge. This role requires someone who can work comfortably with complex financial models, support month‑end close activities, and drive high‑quality financial analysis for decision‑making. The ideal candidate is an Excel super‑user, experienced in building, managing, and reviewing large, integrated 3‑statement financial models. This person must also be able to lean into GAAP‑driven month‑end close review, assisting with accuracy, consistency, and quality checks across financial statements. This position is ideal for someone who has deep hands‑on FP&A experience and is comfortable working in fast‑paced environments where accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail are critical.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Maintain, update, and improve large, complex 3‑statement Excel financial models, ensuring accuracy across income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statements.
  • Conduct regular analysis using these models to support forecasting, variance reviews, and strategic decision‑making.
  • Ensure all links, formulas, and assumptions in the model are correct, transparent, and fully auditable.
  • Serve as the primary owner of the model, performing ongoing quality reviews and consistency checks.
  • Support scenario analysis and sensitivity testing using the 3‑statement model.

GAAP Support & Month‑End Close Review

  • Assist with month‑end close review by applying strong GAAP knowledge to identify potential issues, inconsistencies, or inaccuracies.
  • Perform quality checks across financial statements to ensure GAAP compliance.
  • Collaborate with accounting partners to validate month‑end results and ensure the integrity of reporting.
  • Review month‑end reports and identify accounting adjustments that may be needed.
  • Support the team by ensuring month‑end timelines are met and that deliverables are accurate.

Excel Expertise

  • Act as an Excel super‑user, providing advanced modeling skills including formulas, functions, pivot tables, lookups, and error‑checking.
  • Ensure Excel files and financial models remain organized, consistent, and optimized for performance.
  • Create and maintain documentation of model structure, key assumptions, and calculation methodology.

General FP&A Responsibilities

  • Support core FP&A routines such as monthly reporting, forecasting, and budgeting, using the 3‑statement model as a foundation.
  • Assist with variance analysis by comparing actuals to forecast and identifying key drivers.
  • Provide clear and structured financial information to leadership.
  • Ensure financial analysis and reporting are delivered with precision and attention to detail.
  • Help maintain consistency in financial processes and standards within the FP&A function.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in FP&A or related financial analysis roles.
  • Strong GAAP knowledge and ability to apply it in practical review settings.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including expertise in managing large, integrated models.
  • Prior experience building and maintaining 3‑statement financial models.
  • Strong analytical mindset and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining high accuracy and meeting deadlines.

title: Senior Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Retention—a seasoned CRM strategist and operator who brings equal parts creativity, technical depth, and leadership maturity to the table. This is not a maintenance role; it requires strategic ownership, hands‑on execution, and a bias for measurable impact. You’ll lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to build sophisticated email, SMS, and loyalty programs that drive retention, increase LTV, and power sustained growth for a portfolio of fast‑scaling e‑commerce brands. This role demands sharp customer insight to turn data into strategy, comfort with complexity, and the ability to influence clients and internal stakeholders alike. You’ll report to our Director of Retention and collaborate closely with Performance, Creative, and Strategy teams to deliver cohesive, cross‑channel campaigns rooted in data and customer psychology.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for retention marketers who want to do the best work of their careers—operating at the intersection of personalization, loyalty, and performance‑driven innovation.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Mexico, Brazil, and Spain.

You Should Apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e‑commerce and digital marketing. You immersed in the world of direct‑to‑consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Senior Manager, Retention to join our team! In this role, you will join a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized CRM and retention marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale through email and SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs.

  • 7+ years of work experience in digital marketing.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email and SMS programs.
  • Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.
  • Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. It means continuing to enable decarbonisation and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we share our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

You support the effective management and optimisation of rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs by monitoring and analysing machinery conditions. Your role is crucial in ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency through continuous condition‑based monitoring, data analysis, and collaboration with various teams. You play a key role in troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and guiding the technical team in making informed decisions to prevent failures, enhance equipment lifespan, and support safe and efficient operations.

Responsibilities

  • You support Machinery Engineers and the Maintenance Team in managing the Condition‑Based Program for rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs, including compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, and motors.
  • You review and monitor rotating equipment conditions using vibration data, lube oil results, and other critical operating data (e.g., pressures, temperatures, flows, loads, efficiencies) to assess equipment health.
  • Manage the Vibration & Oil Analysis Database and support issuance of recommendations, consolidating inputs from third parties for the Offshore crew.
  • You are responsible for input actions in the Computerised Maintenance Management System.
  • You follow up on recommendations execution and effectiveness.
  • You perform continuous vibration analysis on equipment with installed Machinery Monitoring Systems (e.g., Bently Nevada System 1).
  • You set up pre‑warnings and alerts to proactively identify potential issues and necessary actions.
  • You collaborate with Operations and Maintenance Personnel, Technical Support Team, and Region Planners to prioritise repairs for identified equipment deficiencies.
  • You assist in troubleshooting by analysing vibration data and other key machine parameters.
  • You provide vibration and oil analysis history to support root‑cause analysis efforts.
  • You offer guidance to the Technical Support Team and System Leads on machinery conditions during task risk assessments and gate reviews (e.g., after major repairs or life‑extension evaluations).
  • You identify and justify the purchase of major predictive equipment spare parts.
  • You provide technical assistance for root‑cause analysis related to ICSS failures and recommend remedial actions.

Education

  • High level of safety awareness and good sense of economics.
  • Offshore survival and medical desirable/required.

Experience

  • Advanced knowledge in the field of Machinery Condition monitoring.
  • Good knowledge of Bently Nevada System 1 or ADRE.
  • Rotor dynamic knowledge.
  • Oil & Gas Experience – FPSO experience preferred.
  • Able to work autonomously and in multi‑disciplinary teams.
  • Must have a proactive approach in combination with a problem‑solving attitude.
  • Good analytical skills and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Effective communication and organisational skills; self‑motivated, enthusiastic and able to work as a team member and communicate effectively with onshore and offshore staff at all levels.
  • Experience with rotating machinery.
  • Experience in the condition monitoring.
  • Must be autonomous and with good team spirit.
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to manage several activities in parallel, combined with flexibility and strong organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally (short term), including offshore.

Skills

  • Mechanical Rotating Equipment – Gas Turbine
  • Mechanical Rotating Equipment – Pumps
  • Mechanical Rotating Equipment – Tribology
  • Integrity and Reliability – Remote Surveillance and Monitoring
  • Learning from events
  • Reliability, operability and safety

  • Project control

description:
Mecânico de Refrigeração Equipe de Obertura RJ - RJ

Vaga: Mecânico de Refrigeração – Equipe de Cobertura (Rio de Janeiro) Estamos buscando um Mecânico de Refrigeração para atuar na equipe de cobertura que atende diferentes contratos em toda a cidade do Rio de Janeiro. A equipe de cobertura não possui posto ou horário fixo: as atividades são direcionadas conforme as demandas diárias informadas pela equipe operacional, que define local, escala e período. O salário é fixo, independentemente da cobertura realizada, e nos dias sem demanda o colaborador permanece na base de um contrato até surgir um novo chamado. As folgas são sempre respeitadas conforme a escala. Essa equipe também é responsável por cobrir ausências por faltas, férias ou atestados.

Atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas de climatização, incluindo Chiller, Fancoil, Self-Contained, Split e ar-condicionado de janela.
  • Executar regulagem de temperaturas, medições de pressão e amperagem.
  • Limpeza de serpentinas, evaporadores, condensadores, bandejas e drenos.
  • Substituição de compressores, motores, filtros secadores, válvulas de expansão, rolamentos, correias, contactores e outros componentes.
  • Efetuar revisão elétrica, reaperto de conexões, lavagem e varetamento de condensadores, manutenção de torres de resfriamento e bombas de água gelada ou condensada.
  • Realizar vácuo, carga e recarga de gás refrigerante, limpeza de tubulações com nitrogênio e inspeção de anomalias, garantindo o pleno desempenho dos sistemas.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em refrigeração.
  • Disponibilidade total de horário para atuar em equipe de cobertura.
  • Certificado na área de refrigeração será considerado diferencial.

description:
Join to apply for the ELETRICISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde .

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar monitoramento do gerador e manutenção da iluminação, tomadas, circuitos e quadros elétricos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Curso completo de Técnico em Elétrica / Curso NR10;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 meses comprovada na função de Eletricista.

description:
Job description

O Grupo Granado abre as portas para você!

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados SR para fazer parte da nossa equipe. Se você é uma pessoa dinâmica, focada e inovadora, esta pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para você. Como Engenheiro de Dados SR , você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter sistemas de coleta, armazenamento e análise de dados. Assegurando que os dados sejam coletados de maneira eficiente, armazenados com segurança e disponibilizados para análise e tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Main responsibilities

  • Desenvolver sistemas e processos para coletar dados de diversas fontes, como bancos de dados, aplicativos, sensores e dispositivos;
  • Projetar e manter bancos de dados e sistemas de armazenamento de dados, incluindo bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Preparar e limpar os dados coletados, garantindo que estejam prontos para análise. Isso envolve a transformação, agregação e padronização de dados;
  • Integrar dados de várias fontes em um único ambiente de dados, garantindo a consistência e a integridade dos dados;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados que automatizem a transferência e transformação de dados de maneira eficiente;
  • Implementar medidas de segurança para proteger os dados contra acessos não autorizados e vazamentos;
  • Colaborar para fornecer conjuntos de dados prontos para análise;
  • Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e otimizar a escalabilidade e a eficiência;
  • Manter documentação completa e atualizada de processos, fluxos de dados e arquitetura de sistemas.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino superior Completo;
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias, soluções e conceitos de Big Data;
  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de versionamento de código Git;
  • Entendimento do ciclo de vida dos dados e conceitos como linhagem, governança, privacidade, retenção, anonimização, etc.;
  • Espírito colaborativo com equipes de Ciência de dados e Analytics, equipe de negócios para entender e atender às necessidades de dados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, compartilhamento proativo e busca de contexto para colaborar com diferentes equipes.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL para processar grandes volumes de dados, garantindo a qualidade e a integridade das informações;
  • Proficiência em Python;
  • Conhecimento dos recursos de nuvem GCP: Storage Transfer Service, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, DataFlow, BigQuery, Dataplex, Cloud Computer;
  • Experiência com Apache Airflow ou outras ferramentas para fluxos de trabalho de dados;
  • Experiência com soluções de armazenamento em colunas e/ou conceitos de data lakehouse;
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de CI/CD, infraestrutura como código (Terraform), observabilidade, entre outras;
  • Entendimento de como a otimização funciona em vários cenários e pode ser melhorada, como desempenho de consulta, escalabilidade de serviço e gerenciamento de cluster;
  • Curiosidade sobre tecnologias em rápida evolução no domínio da engenharia de dados e está ansioso para aprender e dominá-las, trazendo um impacto significativo para nossa equipe.

Additional information

O que voce encontra por aqui:

  • Ambiente integrado, alegre e positivo , onde a colaboração faz parte da rotina.

Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. title: Service Sales Manager
description: At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we'll give you what you need to make it happen. It won't always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you'll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Business Manager - Commercial&Portfolio Role Mission Are you passionate about solutions for the energy, marine, and offshore segments and want to be part of a global company that is transforming the industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for a Service Sales Manager to join our Marine & Ports Division team in Brazil. If you have experience in sales and services in the segments mentioned above, team leadership, and contract negotiation, and are ready to take on major challenges, this opportunity is for you Responsibilities Ensure the execution of the sales strategy for the entire Marine & Ports Division portfolio in Brazil through planning, leadership, and development of the sales team. Create, plan, and implement sales strategies and initiatives for business development, aligned with the global strategy. Set sales targets and monitor their achievement, defining and implementing improvement plans. Identify opportunities with new, existing, and potential customers within the country, adjusting the sales plan and resource allocation when necessary. Develop strong relationships with key customers, decision-makers, as well as associations and representative entities in the marine and offshore segments, ensuring efficient communication and customer satisfaction. Participate in negotiations of service contracts with strategic customers and ensure previously established margins. Lead and develop the sales team, maintaining a healthy, organized environment with qualified and focused professionals. Requirements Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Naval Engineering, or Automation (highly desirable). Proven experience in sales and services, preferably in the energy, marine, and offshore segments. Solid experience in leadership and people management, with availability for frequent travel. Proven track record of closing deals and negotiating service contracts. Fluent English for conversation and writing is mandatory. Must reside in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói, or Macaé. Active Category B driver's license is required. Differentials Knowledge of ship electrical systems (generation, distribution, and propulsion) and digital services. What We Offer Be part of a global company involved in high-impact projects in the marine and port sectors. A collaborative environment with continuous learning, access to training, and advanced technologies. Career development opportunities in a solid technical and commercial path, with growth potential within the organization. About ABB Marine & Ports Division ABB Marine & Ports is a global leader in electrical, digital, and automated solutions for vessels and port infrastructure. With a robust portfolio that includes electric propulsion systems, energy management, and digital services, we deliver solutions that increase efficiency, reduce emissions, and drive sustainable transformation in the marine industry. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Data Strategy Supervisor
description:
Descrição

Buscamos uma pessoa que virá para agregar valor aos projetos aplicando gestão de dados e métricas de mídia para garantir assertividade nas estratégias propostas aos clientes.

Estamos em busca de pessoas que desejam se desafiar e que sejam incansáveis em busca do aprendizado. 

Quer fazer parte da Spark e desbravar todo o potencial do Marketing de Influência? 

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Supervisionar a rotina técnica do time, garantindo adesão a cronogramas e SLAs de entregas. Supervisionar entregas de relatórios e análises, assegurando excelência, acurácia e qualidade dos dados apresentados a clientes e liderança. Criar e validar escopos de extração de dados (bases manuais e automação) para métricas de creators, engajamento e performance de campanhas. Validar documentação de escopo, garantindo assertividade técnica e alinhamento com objetivos de negócio. Garantir fluxo de comunicação eficiente entre o time interno (analistas, BI, criação) e stakeholders. Realizar apresentações de alto nível para clientes, demonstrando domínio técnico de dados de influência (ER, autenticidade, ROI, segmentação). Validar e sugerir implementações de tags de tracking para campanhas em plataformas sociais e tools de influência. Mapear e compreender o ecossistema completo do cliente (audiência, canais, creators, funil de conversão), gerando análises aprofundadas e recomendações estratégicas. Monitorar KPIs críticos (engajamento real, lifetime value de audiência, benchmark de mercado) e propor otimizações baseadas em dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Superior completo em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Experiência comprovada em análise de dados no setor de marketing digital/influência ou publicidade. Domínio avançado de ferramentas: Google Analytics, Looker Studio/Tableau, Power BI, Excel avançado, Google Tag Manager. Experiência com métricas de social media e influência.  Domínio em Google Sheets e plataformas de mídia.
